title: 褪色的窗

realEventsMapping.real: 周一早上 7 点画了第一张速写
realEventsMapping.story: 林夏第一次拿起修补笔，面包店的窗框亮了一角

realEventsMapping.real: 周三把手机放在客厅画了 40 分钟
realEventsMapping.story: 灰雾的低语第一次没能穿过房门

realEventsMapping.real: 周五画完第五张人体速写
realEventsMapping.story: 整扇窗户恢复了原本的天蓝色

beats: 雾港清晨，林夏注意到面包店的窗户已经褪成灰白
她第一次拿起铅笔，灰雾在耳边说“明天再画吧”
连续几个早晨的练习后，窗户一点点亮起来，阿婆送来热面包
周五傍晚，窗户完全恢复，港口尽头的灯塔闪了一下

panels.scene: A quiet foggy seaside town at dawn, the protagonist stands in front of a faded grey bakery window, holding a sketchbook, looking determined
panels.narration: 雾港的清晨，一切都是灰色的。

panels.scene: Close-up of the protagonist sketching at a small desk by the window, soft grey mist curling near her ear like a whisper, phone face-down on the table
The old baker woman hands the protagonist a warm loaf of bread, the bakery window behind them is half restored to bright sky blue
Sunset over the harbor, the fully restored blue window glowing, a distant old lighthouse at the end of the pier flashing once, the future self silhouette standing far away on the pier

coverPrompt: A young woman holding a pencil in front of a faded bakery window in a foggy seaside town, first light of dawn
interviewQuote: 画第三张的时候手终于不抖了
cliffhanger: 港口尽头，有人朝她挥了挥手——那个人的围巾，是芥末黄色的。

foreshadowingAdd.hint: 墨点总在林夏画画时出现在窗台

summary: 林夏在雾港醒来，发现面包店的窗户褪成灰白。她每天清晨练习作画，顶住灰雾的低语，用五个早晨让窗户恢复了天蓝色，获得阿婆的第一块热面包。章末灯塔闪了一下，远处出现一个系着芥末黄围巾的身影。
